description:
Earth has frozen over many times, and Doug takes the time machine to each freeze: from the 1816 Year Without a Summer and the Thames frost fairs, through the ice ages and the moment Antarctica iced over, back to Snowball Earth, when ice reached the tropics, and a freeze 2.4 billion years ago that life itself may have caused (possibly the first Snowball Earth ever).

The planet has frozen. Where should Doug go when it heats up instead? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad day.
